title: validate_session_urls uses string-split for scheme extraction instead of url::Url::parse
description: client.rs lines 512-515: validate_session_urls splits URL strings on '://' to extract the scheme. This is a heuristic that would accept 'ftp://foo' with scheme 'ftp' but would misclassify a URL with no '://' as having an empty scheme (which happens to work by coincidence). The url crate (already a direct dependency via url::Url for base_url) provides url::Url::parse() which does proper scheme extraction. Idiomatic: parse each URL with url::Url::parse() and check .scheme(). Note: the RFC 6570 template URLs (upload_url, download_url, event_source_url) contain {placeholders} that url::Url::parse() would reject — but the scheme check is prefix-only, so extracting just the scheme prefix before the first '{' would work, or parse only api_url with url::Url.
